newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bank Austria wins bid for Creditanstalt-Vranitzky.
newsitem.headline: Bank Austria wins bid for Creditanstalt-Vranitzky.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Franz Vranitzky said on Sunday Bank Austria had won the bid to buy flagship bank Creditanstalt.

"I can tell you that the state's stake in Creditanstalt will go to the highest bidder which is Bank Austria," he told reporters after marathon talks between coalition leaders of his Social Democratic Party and the conservative People's Party.

Vranitzky said Bank Austria would be taken out of public control step by step. The bank is effectively controlled by the Social Democrat-dominated City of Vienna through its Anteilsverwaltung Zentralsparkasse (AVZ) foundation.
AVZ directly owns around 46 percent of Bank Austria voting shares and also guarantees the bank's liabilities.
